name: Cape: App to Pause Excess
description:
If you find yourself spending too much time on social media, short-form videos, or games, Cape can help you stay focused by pausing excess app usage and restoring access at the right time.

By adding gentle pauses and clear boundaries, Cape helps reduce distraction, curb impulsive app openings, and support healthier digital habits -— especially for people who struggle with attention or ADHD-related challenges.

What you can do with Cape:

- Set daily screen time limits: Apps pause automatically when you reach your limit.
- Take a Break: Cape pauses apps after extended usage and resumes them automatically once your break ends.
- Customize the Pause Screen with a personal message, countdown, and usage summary, shown when you open paused apps to help you stay mindful.
- Use On-demand Access and Delayed Resume to reduce impulsive app openings.
- Automate with Allow Zones & Block Zones, schedules, and Shortcuts to control access automatically.
- Stay informed with notifications and reports.

With Cape, pausing excess screen time becomes automatic, intentional, and easy.

Orders can be tracked in the app from confirmation to delivery, with order history and invoices available at any time.

PERSONALISED VIDEO CONTENT
After completing the diagnostic, the app provides video content on how and when to use each recommended product.

THE LIBRARY
The Library contains articles on ingredients, active compounds and skin topics, covering the reasoning behind Typology's formulation choices.

TYPOLOGY PREMIER
Typology Premier is an annual subscription including free standard shipping with no minimum order, a 10% discount on every online order, and early access to a selection of new launches.
